newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK CBANK SETS NO REFINANCING REPO ON TUESDAY.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK CBANK SETS NO REFINANCING REPO ON TUESDAY.

text.p: The National Bank of Slovakia (NBS) said in a statement it would not hold any refinancing repo tenders on Tuesday.
The NBS also said it planned to drain some excess liquidity from the interbank market by selling treasury bills from its portfolio. The T-bills slated for sale will mature in 58 days.
According to NBS figures, the Slovak banking sector, as of August 11, exceeded by 2.75 percent the cumulative volume of funds needed to meet minimum reserves requirements later this month.
The daily volume of minimum reserves for commercial banks totals 36.817 billion crowns ($1.1 billion) in the current reserves period ending August 15.
-- Peter Laca, Bratislava Newsroom, 421-7-521-8402 ($ = 34.92 Slovak Crowns)
